FactionDef.label: multicultural tribe
FactionDef.description: A tribe of various races united under a singular purpose. While rough around the edges, they are generally open to diplomacy and won't attack unless angered. They largely originate from other tribes, having come apart and together again numerous times throughout the ages. As a result, they have little idea of where they came from or who their ancestors were.

FactionDef.label: multicultural union
FactionDef.description: A union of various races united under a singular purpose. These settlements have been present on the planet for anywhere from decades to centuries and they have retained some level of technology. They are open to diplomacy but will fiercely defend themselves if attacked.\n\nThey possess a wide variety of xenohumans.

FactionDef.label: rough multicultural union
FactionDef.description: A rough and tumble union, united only in a very loose sense. These groups are inherently suspicious of others and will raid and pillage those they see as outsiders. However, if sufficiently convinced, they can prove to be a powerful ally.\n\nThey possess a wide variety of xenohumans.

FactionDef.label: adoptive pirate gang
FactionDef.description: Born from a disparate band of kitul pirates, this group has largely committed to only raiding outsiders. They are fierce and committed, but also highly diverse. Many of their kidnapped members find themselves adopted.\n\nWhile their sense of internal kinship is strong, these pirates are utterly disinterested in diplomacy. If they want what you have, they will take it.
